$comment: Size and perf ceilings for npm run perf:budget / perf:budget:ci. Ratchet rule: shrinking a metric lowers its ceiling in the same PR; raising one needs Yasin's OK. Historical logs live in git log.

appBytes.$comment: Packaged macOS .app total bytes (measured 320.19 MB on yaz-6008-speed).

asarBytes.$comment: app.asar bytes inside .app (measured 76.97 MB on yaz-6008-speed).

dmgBytes.$comment: Compressed arm64 DMG bytes (measured 105.64 MB on yaz-6008-speed).

lprojCount.$comment: App-level .lproj markers kept so OS Open/Save panels match macOS language.

asarNodeModulesFiles.$comment: Unbundled node_modules files inside app.asar (must stay 0).

rendererEagerJsBytes.$comment: Renderer entry JS static import closure bytes (measured 2.96 MB on yaz-6008-speed).

rendererEagerCssBytes.$comment: Renderer entry CSS static closure bytes (measured 0.28 MB on yaz-6008-speed).

rendererTotalBytes.$comment: Renderer out/ total bytes excluding excalidraw-assets (measured 31.47 MB on yaz-6008-speed).

mainBundleBytes.$comment: Main process and CLI bundle bytes in out/main (measured 0.85 MB on yaz-6008-speed).

shareViewerBytes.$comment: Share-link viewer bundle bytes in share/dist/assets (measured 2.17 MB on yaz-6008-speed).

perf.$comment: Local harness timing and memory ceilings (npm run perf).
